lumipore.name: Spavio Lumipore 4-in-1
lumipore.effect: 4 Light Modes: Warmth, Serum Boost, Micro-Lifting, Glow
lumipore.description: One device, four care modes for a spa feeling at home: red light with gentle warmth for a fresh, rosy complexion; green light with microcurrent to help serums and creams absorb; blue light with EMS pulses for firmer-looking skin; and yellow light to soothe and restore radiance.
lumipore.editorsNotes: "Four light modes in one slim wand — the easiest way to start a device routine."

lumina-led-mask.name: Lumina Pro LED Face Mask
lumina-led-mask.description: A flexible, medical-grade silicone mask with 160 LEDs delivering red (630nm) and near-infrared (830nm) light to support collagen, even tone and calm redness in just 10 minutes a day.
lumina-led-mask.editorsNotes: "The easiest glow ritual we know — put it on, press play, and let the light do the work."

sculpt-microcurrent.name: Sculpt Microcurrent Toning Device
sculpt-microcurrent.description: Twin rotating spheres deliver gentle microcurrent to tone facial muscles along the jawline, cheekbones and brows. Five intensity levels and a guided 5-minute routine.
sculpt-microcurrent.editorsNotes: "A five-minute facial workout that visibly sharpens your contours before an event."

thermalift-rf.name: ThermaLift RF Skin Tightener
thermalift-rf.description: Multipolar radiofrequency warms the deeper layers of the skin to a comfortable 40–42°C, with built-in temperature sensing that keeps every session safe and consistent.
thermalift-rf.editorsNotes: "Clinic-style firming, calibrated for home. The smart sensor makes it effortless."

sonic-cleanse-brush.name: Sonic Cleanse Facial Brush
sonic-cleanse-brush.description: Ultra-soft, hygienic silicone touch-points pulse at 8,000 sonic vibrations per minute to lift away makeup, SPF and impurities — gentle enough for twice-daily use.
sonic-cleanse-brush.editorsNotes: "Cleaner skin in 60 seconds. Waterproof, travel-ready and a single charge lasts for months."

aqua-ion-infuser.name: Aqua Ion Serum Infuser
aqua-ion-infuser.description: Ultrasonic vibration and ionic modes help your favourite serums and moisturisers work into the skin, while the cool-touch stainless head soothes and de-puffs.
aqua-ion-infuser.editorsNotes: "Make every drop of serum count — a quiet upgrade to your existing routine."

eye-revive-wand.name: Eye Revive Heated Massager
eye-revive-wand.description: A pen-sized wand with a warming 42°C tip and gentle sonic pulses that relax the delicate eye area and help eye creams absorb.
eye-revive-wand.editorsNotes: "Our morning secret for brighter, less tired-looking eyes."

cryo-glow-roller.name: Cryo Glow Ice Roller
cryo-glow-roller.description: A stainless-steel cryo roller that stays cold for up to 20 minutes after chilling. Calms redness, tightens the look of pores and pairs perfectly with post-treatment care.
cryo-glow-roller.editorsNotes: "Keep it in the fridge — two minutes of rolling feels like a spa reset."

silk-ipl.name: Silk IPL Hair Removal
silk-ipl.description: Intense pulsed light with an integrated skin-tone sensor and five energy levels. Visible hair reduction in as few as four weekly sessions, with an ice-cool sapphire window for comfort.
silk-ipl.editorsNotes: "Salon-level IPL at home, with the sensor doing the guesswork for you."

precision-trimmer.name: Precision Face & Brow Trimmer
precision-trimmer.description: A slim, whisper-quiet trimmer with five interchangeable heads for brows, upper lip, face and fine body hair. Hypoallergenic blades for sensitive skin.
precision-trimmer.editorsNotes: "The detail tool everyone should have in their vanity."

aura-ionic-dryer.name: Aura Ionic Hair Dryer
aura-ionic-dryer.description: A 110,000 RPM brushless motor with 200 million negative ions per cm³ for quick, glossy blow-dries. Intelligent heat control measures air temperature 40 times per second.
aura-ionic-dryer.editorsNotes: "Lightweight, powerful and quiet — a salon blow-dry without the heat damage."

glide-straightener.name: Glide Infrared Straightener
glide-straightener.description: Floating ceramic plates infused with infrared technology heat evenly from 150–230°C for sleek, shiny results in a single pass. Auto shut-off after 60 minutes.
glide-straightener.editorsNotes: "Straightens, curls and waves — one tool for every look."

scalp-revive.name: Scalp Revive Massager
scalp-revive.description: Waterproof, rotating kneading nodes and red-light therapy stimulate the scalp, support circulation and turn your hair-wash into a mini head spa.
scalp-revive.editorsNotes: "Ten minutes of pure relaxation — and your scalp will thank you."

pulse-mini-massager.name: Pulse Mini Massage Gun
pulse-mini-massager.description: Compact percussion therapy with four speeds and four attachments. Relieves tension in neck, shoulders and legs — small enough for any handbag.
pulse-mini-massager.editorsNotes: "Powerful relief that fits in the palm of your hand."

contour-body-sculptor.name: Contour Body Sculptor
contour-body-sculptor.description: Combines EMS muscle stimulation with warming radiofrequency and triple rolling heads to smooth and firm the look of thighs, arms and abdomen.
contour-body-sculptor.editorsNotes: "A body-contouring ritual that feels like a warm, deep massage."
